capabilities.name: Workspace Persistence Across Sandbox Restarts
capabilities.explanation: Demonstrates stopping and resuming an isolated Celesto sandbox while maintaining full workspace file and environmental state across lifecycles, enabling multi-step agent recovery without compute repetition.

capabilities.name: Native Command Lifecycle Veto Callbacks
capabilities.explanation: Enforces strict pre-execution validation using Celesto's native callback hooks; raising CommandBlockedError aborts dangerous shell commands and exfiltration before they ever reach the guest microVM.
